cards.english_title: Theni Jailbreak Puts Tamil Nadu Government Under Pressure
cards.korean_desc: 10월 26일 테니에서 수감자 17명이 탈출했다. 10월 28일 13명 검거, 직원 9명 정직됐다.
cards.english_desc: Seventeen remand prisoners escaped from Thekkampatti jail in Theni on October 26, 2026. By October 28, police had caught thirteen escapees and suspended nine staff members.
cards.hook: Seventeen prisoners escaped; thirteen were caught.
cards.takeaway_english: The immediate question is whether prison reforms will prevent another escape.
cards.takeaway_korean: 당장은 교도소 개혁이 재탈옥을 막을지 중요하다.

why_it_matters.english: Prison escapes can raise public-safety concerns beyond the jail.
why_it_matters.korean: 탈옥은 교도소 밖 안전도 걱정하게 한다.

why_it_matters.english: The case puts staffing, cameras, and supervision under scrutiny.

parties.label: Tamil Nadu government
parties.english: It faces criticism after the mass escape and prison-security questions.
parties.korean: 대규모 탈옥 뒤 비판을 받고 있다.

parties.label: Police
parties.english: They caught thirteen escapees and continued searching for four.

parties.label: Nine prison staff
parties.english: They were suspended over the security lapse.

views.label: Edappadi K. Palaniswami
views.english: He questioned whether the chief minister's prison review was genuine.

views.label: T. T. V. Dhinakaran
views.english: He asked about staffing, cameras, procedures, and senior inspections.

disagree.english: Supporters may say suspensions and searches show the government is already responding.
disagree.korean: 지지자들은 정부가 이미 대응한다고 말할 수 있다.

cards.english_title: Indian Stocks Slide as Oil Rises Before the Fed Decision
cards.korean_desc: 2026년 10월 28일 인도 주식이 내렸다. 인도는 에너지를 많이 수입해 유가가 부담이다. 브렌트유는 1.5% 올라 115.36달러였다. 연준은 10월 28일 금리 동결이 예상됐다.
cards.english_desc: Indian stocks fell on October 28, 2026, before the U.S. Federal Reserve decision. Rising crude prices hurt sentiment because India imports much of its energy. Brent crude rose 1.5% to $115.36, while WTI reached $101.12. The Fed was widely expected to keep rates at 3.75% to 4.00% on October 28.
cards.takeaway_english: Markets were watching whether oil or the Fed would set the next direction.

parties.korean: 미국 결정 전 유가 걱정에 직면했다.

cards.english_title: European Porcelain Reimagined Indian Gods for Indian Buyers
cards.korean_desc: 아닐 렐리아가 아마다바드에서 외국 도자기를 전시한다. 인도 석판화는 값싼 신앙 물건 판매를 도왔다. 전시는 도자기 124점과 석판화 36점을 비교한다.
cards.english_desc: Anil Relia's Ahmedabad exhibition shows European and Japanese porcelain Hindu figures. Indian lithographs helped European traders sell affordable devotional objects in India. The exhibition compares 124 porcelain objects with about 36 lithographs.
cards.hook: Indian gods became European porcelain figures.
cards.takeaway_english: The exhibition turns strange-looking objects into evidence of a complicated art economy.
cards.takeaway_korean: 전시는 낯선 물건을 복잡한 미술 경제의 증거로 바꾼다.

why_it_matters.english: The objects connect home worship with global trade and printing.
why_it_matters.korean: 물건들은 가정 신앙과 세계 무역을 연결한다.

why_it_matters.english: The exhibition questions the boundary between high art and popular art.
why_it_matters.korean: 전시는 고급 예술과 대중 예술의 경계를 묻는다.

parties.label: Anil Relia
parties.english: He argues that neglected devotional objects belong in Indian art history.
parties.korean: 그는 소외된 신앙 물건도 미술사에 속한다고 본다.

parties.label: European traders
parties.english: They saw commercial value in popular Indian religious prints.
parties.korean: 유럽 상인들은 인기 종교 판화에서 사업 기회를 봤다.

parties.label: Museum visitors
parties.english: They can compare printed images with three-dimensional figures.
parties.korean: 관람객은 판화와 입체 조각을 비교할 수 있다.

views.label: Collector's view
views.english: The figures show cultural exchange, commerce, and changing devotional art.
views.korean: 이 도자기는 문화 교류와 상업을 보여 준다.

views.label: Critical view
views.english: European makers often misunderstood Indian bodies, poses, and visual details.
views.korean: 유럽 장인은 인도 모습과 자세를 자주 오해했다.

disagree.english: Some may value the figures mainly as devotional objects rather than colonial-era art.
disagree.korean: 일부는 이를 식민지 미술보다 신앙 물건으로 볼 수 있다.

cards.english_title: Stan Wawrinka Ends His Career with a Basel Defeat
cards.korean_desc: 바브린카는 10월 27일 바젤에서 레헤치카에게 졌다. 41세 바브린카는 2026년 은퇴를 예고했다. 그는 호주오픈, 프랑스오픈, US오픈을 우승했다. 그는 ATP 우승 16회와 세계 3위를 남겼다.
cards.english_desc: Stan Wawrinka lost 7-5, 7-6(2) to Jiri Lehecka in Basel on October 27, 2026. The 41-year-old had announced that 2026 would be his final season. He won the 2014 Australian Open, 2015 French Open, and 2016 U.S. Open. He leaves tennis with 16 ATP titles and a career-high ranking of third.
cards.hook: Wawrinka lost his final match at home.
cards.takeaway_english: Basel closed the playing chapter, but Wawrinka's records remain part of tennis history.
cards.takeaway_korean: 바젤은 경기의 막을 닫았지만 기록은 남았다.

why_it_matters.english: His farewell shows how elite careers can end in one ordinary match.
why_it_matters.korean: 최고 선수의 경력도 한 경기로 끝날 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: His titles came during the era of Federer, Nadal, Djokovic, and Murray.
why_it_matters.korean: 그의 우승은 강한 선수들이 있던 시대에 나왔다.

parties.label: Stan Wawrinka
parties.english: He ended a 24-year professional career at age 41.

parties.label: Jiri Lehecka
parties.english: He won the final match 7-5, 7-6(2) in Basel.

parties.label: Swiss fans
parties.english: They watched Wawrinka's farewell at his home tournament.
parties.korean: 스위스 팬들은 홈 대회 작별을 지켜봤다.

views.label: Wawrinka
views.english: He said giving everything and avoiding regret mattered most.
views.korean: 바브린카는 최선을 다해 후회가 없었다고 말했다.

views.label: Tennis observers
views.english: They see his three major titles as a major achievement in a strong era.
views.korean: 테니스계는 그의 메이저 3승을 큰 성과로 본다.

cards.english_title: Sydney Exhibition Shows Vishnu Through 1,500 Years of Art
cards.korean_desc: 시드니 미술관은 2026년 비슈누 작품 약 200점을 전시했다. 전시는 남아시아와 동남아시아의 다양한 비슈누를 보여줬다. 현대 작가 9명은 신화와 젠더, 기억, 권력을 연결했다.
cards.english_desc: Sydney's Art Gallery of New South Wales presented nearly 200 Vishnu works in 2026. The show explored how artists reimagined Vishnu across South and Southeast Asia. Nine contemporary artists connected mythology with gender, memory, and power.
cards.hook: Sydney showed Vishnu in many forms.
cards.takeaway_english: The exhibition treats Vishnu's many forms as a continuing artistic conversation.
cards.takeaway_korean: 전시는 비슈누의 여러 모습을 이어지는 예술 대화로 본다.

why_it_matters.english: The exhibition shows that mythological images change across regions and centuries.
why_it_matters.korean: 전시는 신화 이미지가 시대와 지역에 따라 변함을 보여 준다.

why_it_matters.english: Contemporary artists use old stories to discuss modern questions.
why_it_matters.korean: 현대 작가들은 옛이야기로 오늘의 문제를 말한다.

parties.label: Art Gallery of New South Wales
parties.english: It hosted nearly 200 works from South and Southeast Asia.

parties.label: Chaitanya Sambrani
parties.english: He co-curated the exhibition and stressed artistic and philosophical ideas.
parties.korean: 그는 전시를 공동 기획하고 예술을 강조했다.

parties.label: Contemporary artists
parties.english: Nine artists used Vishnu stories to explore gender, memory, and power.

views.label: Curators
views.english: They present Vishnu as an inclusive cultural, artistic, and philosophical idea.
views.korean: 기획자들은 비슈누를 포괄적인 문화와 예술로 본다.

views.label: Devotional viewers
views.english: They may value the works first as sacred images rather than museum objects.
views.korean: 신앙인들은 작품을 먼저 성스러운 이미지로 볼 수 있다.

disagree.english: Some viewers may question whether museum language can fully represent religious meaning.
disagree.korean: 일부 관람객은 박물관 설명이 신앙 의미를 충분히 담는지 물을 수 있다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 박물관은 성스러운 미술을 신앙과 역사 중 무엇으로 설명해야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Saudi Refinery Attack Sends Oil Prices Higher
cards.korean_desc: 2026년 10월 28일 후티 공격 주장 뒤 유가가 올랐다. 브렌트유는 1.4% 올라 115.47달러였다. 사우디 당국은 10월 28일 공격을 확인하지 않았다. 시장은 미국 재고와 11월 1일 OPEC+ 회의를 지켜본다.
cards.english_desc: Oil rose on October 28, 2026, after Houthis claimed a Saudi refinery missile strike. Brent gained 1.4% to $115.47, while WTI reached $101.33. Saudi authorities had not immediately confirmed the strike on October 28. Markets will watch U.S. inventory data and the November 1 OPEC+ meeting.

why_it_matters.english: The incident links regional conflict with global energy security.
